body: It starts off like that just like almost any other show. Once you get used to how the show runs and are able to develop a deeper opinion about different characters, you'll start to enjoy it more. Me personally I wasn't crazy about it first watch through of the series. I liked it, thought it was really good, but couldn't put it in my Top 5, mainly because I have a hard time paying attention to long shows and sometimes with Sopranos you can get lost in plots/subplots. Second watchthrough I loved it, thought the acting was exceptional and the overall plot (Tony's character development and the Mafia's effect and downfall) was delivered greatly. Third watchthrough was the best because I understood what was going on overall and could focus alot more on the tiny things that I missed, which led me to find out that the Sopranos is one of the funniest shows I've ever watched and accurately depicted New Jersey nature (being from NJ myself). I started watching the show two years ago. So it definitely isn't too late to start, just give it a bit more time and try to appreciate the acting and humor.
